plan.scene: A snow-covered plain at sunrise: smooth deep snow with wind ripples, a low snowy mound behind her, frosted pine trees and pale blue mountains far away, pink and gold sunrise light.

shots.what: one continuous locked-off shot: the woman sits calmly in a folding chair facing the camera, salutes casually, a truck launches over the mound behind her, soars through the air and slams down right behind her chair in a huge cloud of snow, she lowers her sunglasses and smirks

subjects.role: the person sitting calmly in the folding chair at the centre, facing the camera
subjects.traits: a young woman with a sleek platinum-blonde bob and silver mirrored sunglasses, wearing a long cream-white puffer coat, white wide trousers and white boots, sitting in a white folding chair

subjects.role: the pickup truck that jumps over the mound and lands behind the chair
subjects.traits: a bright papaya-orange off-road rally pickup truck with chunky black tyres, a black roof light bar and black fender flares

constraints: No text, captions, logos, badges, license plates or watermarks.
Snow and powdery snow spray everywhere instead of grass, dirt and dust.
She stays seated and calm the whole time.
